Curate parent-approved video playlists for each child. Kids get their own YouTube home — nothing else.

Review what they noticed. Blocking removes that YouTube ID from the channel or playlist it came from for everyone.

Add a Video to Library

Paste a YouTube URL or video ID and choose Add URL / ID, or search YouTube. Review the details, then add it to the library.

Add a YouTube Channel

Add a whole curated YouTube channel. BodeeGuard imports every public upload, removes videos that cannot play safely, and keeps the complete catalog searchable for kids.

Find it in the channel's YouTube URL: youtube.com/channel/UCxxxxxxxx

learning-videos:
Learning Videos

A separate school-side video library for lessons such as states and capitals, science explanations, and memory songs.

Always available for learning

These videos appear beside school and writing. They do not use recreational video time, wait for school completion, obey the leisure-video hours, or disappear after being watched. A computer-wide parent lock still pauses everything.

Add a Learning Video

Paste a public or unlisted YouTube URL/video ID, or search YouTube without leaving BodeeGuard. Exact parent-pasted unlisted links are allowed even when YouTube hides their public metadata; search and channel imports remain public-only.

Learning Library

All active videos are available to every child.
